messages:
alex: ProspectCo wants a drop-in replacement for CompetitorX. main asks: adapter, prompt parity, streaming chunk behavior, pricing delta, and security questionnaire. looping in SE/infra/legal. cc @mira @devin @sophia @ben @olga

mira: suggest 10 canonical prompts + 1k sessions for a 10-day POC. week1 parity, week2 load + billing. need their exact headers and streaming format.

devin: CompetitorX uses `Authorization: ApiKey <key>` and streams with `event: delta` base64 payloads. will replicate both tiers (burst/steady).

sophia: infra can provision a temporary compat endpoint `sandbox.redwood.com/prospectco-compat`. need allowlist CIDR and expected qps.

ben: security: they sent vendor questionnaire. flagged items: EU data residency, KMS rotation proof, and pen test. we can supply SOC2 + redacted pen test; HSM requests extend timeline.

olga: legal: they asked for indemnity on model outputs. we decline broad indemnity; offer limited liability cap and content-disclaimer. need ARR to evaluate concessions.

alex: ARR ~$450k ACV. procurement contact is kate.procure@prospectco.com. they prefer hosted first.

mira: evaluation metrics proposal: top-1 embedding cosine >= 0.86, avg token delta < 10, streaming 95p latency <1.5x. ok?

devin: will add token-compare and streaming-normalizer to runner. sample shim snippet posted to repo.

sophia: sandbox provisioned: https://sandbox.redwood.com/prospectco-compat (expires 12d). IP allowlist configured.

ben: sending SOC2 cert + KMS rotation logs. ask them if audit-export is sufficient instead of HSM.

olga: I'll redline their DPA + vendor Q and circulate.

alex: action items: devin -> runner + shim; mira -> prompts + eval checklist; sophia -> sandbox; ben -> security docs; olga -> legal redlines. kickoff Mon 11am PT. any blockers?

ben: blocker only if they insist on HSM or strict EU-only hosting for product (POC ok).

kate (prospectco via email): uploaded sessions here: https://files.prospectco.com/poc-uploads (access in DM).

mira: running first-pass parity tests tonight, will post results tomorrow morning.

alex: thanks team, keep updates short in this thread.
